# The numbers of the clauses of IEEE 1800-2023 from 3 to 40, the clauses that
# the tests cite in :lrm:, which tools/suite_catalog.py compares with the tests
# (docs/tests/clauses.md). The titles are in the standard. A tag after a number
# marks a clause that no test is expected to cite:
#   none      it sets out no behavior of its own: general text, an overview,
#             examples, a syntax summary, a list or a diagram key, or a PLI
#             region that no callback of Table 4-1 is scheduled in
#   excluded  clause 34, protected envelopes (see "Contents" in README.md)
#   tool      it leaves the behavior to the tool or its setup, which tests
#             cannot fix: library map files and compilation models, VPI
#             compatibility modes, save and restart, options for pulse limits
#             and negative timing checks, and behavior that a tool "may" have
#             or that only shows in a warning or in a report of the tool's
#             own form, and VPI objects that the standard gives no way to
#             reach, such as the delay devices of 37.45
#   dump      the content of VCD files, which the tests do not read back
